text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian has won the autumn Tenno Sho. Though defeated, Matikanetannhauser is motivated to strive for victory next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, expectations grow for a sisterly showdown with Biwa Hayahide, but her return to racing looks doubtful…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian does her best not to think of her sister's injury, instead focusing on the Japan Cup.
